full_judgment: 9. The petitioner by filing supplementary affidavit further stated that after the Additional Assistant Judge, Barisal, decreed Title Suit No.17 of 1991 on 6.4.91, the petitioners applied on 3.11.91 to the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Barisal under section 143 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1951 for correction of the record of right relating to the suit land which was registered as Misc. Case No.750 (2) KT/91-92. After notice to the other parties noted in that application the matter was disposed of by the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Barisal by his order dated 8-1-92. In pursuance of the order passed by the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Barisal a new khatian bearing No.6193 was opened in the names of the petitioners in respect of .127 decimals of land of Mouza Bogura Alekanda JL No. 50. Rent of Taka 2074.75 was realised from the petitioners for 1387 BS on 26-2-92 and the rent of Taka 76.20 for 1389 BS was realised on 27-2-92.
